verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports using Mercury's own auto-funding rules across dozens of purpose-named accounts, which suggests native auto top-up between accounts. No first-party documentation describes these rules, and no native low-balance alert feature is evidenced. The internal-transfer API and balance-change webhooks are only developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of auto-transfer/top-up rules (triggers, thresholds, scheduling), native low-balance alerts, independent corroboration beyond a single community comment.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts

citations.quote: dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules
